text: The criterion title says `POST /api/chat` with an empty field `message` and a non-empty annotation list is accepted. The request DTO `chat-request` has no `message` field: the user's message is `prompt` ("may be empty if there are annotations"). Assumed `message` means `prompt`; the test sends `{ prompt: '', annotations: [...] }`. Suggest retitling the criterion to name `prompt`.
assumption: ASSUMPTION:dev-0001 — the criterion says "field `message`"; the request DTO (`chat-request`) names the message field `prompt`, so `prompt` is what is sent.
